info.description: 按 2026-11-11 当前接口更新。完整运行时按文件夹顺序执行；每轮创建随机测试账号，自动登录并在结束前删除测试对话、退出测试账号。base_url 指向隔离测试服务，HTTP 下 auth.secure_cookie=false；测试配置 auth.operation_attempts/login_attempts=1000。密码默认 8–128 字符。聊天使用第一个可用模型，运行会调用模型。Cookie 与运行状态仅存 pm.variables，不写回集合变量。邮箱完整流程需 test_mail_url 测试收件桥（见本地 postman/README.md）；未配置时跳过邮箱文件夹。

item.name: 04 聊天持久化、幂等与回复版本
item.description: 执行模型生成，使用真实上游时会产生调用。

exec: pm.test("完整 JSON 回复契约", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.conversation_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("conversation_id")); [b.user_message_id,b.assistant_message_id].forEach(id=>pm.expect(id).to.match(/^[1-9][0-9]*$/)); pm.expect(b.reply).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.reasoning).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.finish_reason).to.be.oneOf(["stop","length","refusal","other"]); pm.expect(b.truncated).to.eql(b.finish_reason==="length"); });

item.name: 04 回复已提交历史且未重复插入

exec: pm.test("历史和原回复一致", () => { const b=pm.response.json(),r=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("first_reply")); pm.expect(b.messages).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(b.messages[1].id).to.eql(r.assistant_message_id); pm.expect(b.messages[1].content).to.eql(r.reply); pm.expect(b.messages[1].reasoning).to.eql(r.reasoning); pm.expect(b.messages[1].state).to.eql("completed"); pm.expect(b.conversation.current_message_id).to.eql(r.assistant_message_id); pm.expect(b.conversation.active_message_id).to.eql(null); });

exec: pm.test("完整 JSON 回复契约", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.conversation_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("conversation_id")); [b.user_message_id,b.assistant_message_id].forEach(id=>pm.expect(id).to.match(/^[1-9][0-9]*$/)); pm.expect(b.reply).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.reasoning).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(b.finish_reason).to.be.oneOf(["stop","length","refusal","other"]); pm.expect(b.truncated).to.eql(b.finish_reason==="length"); });

pm.test("重新生成保留问题 ID", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.user_message_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("first_user")); pm.expect(b.assistant_message_id).not.to.eql(pm.variables.get("first_assistant")); pm.variables.set("regenerated_assistant",b.assistant_message_id); });

exec: pm.test("消息游标", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(b.next_before).to.be.a("string"); pm.variables.set("message_before",b.next_before); pm.variables.set("message_page_ids",JSON.stringify(b.items.map(m=>m.id))); });

item.name: 12 消息分页下一页无重复

exec: pm.test("消息页无重复", () => { const b=pm.response.json(),ids=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("message_page_ids")); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(2); b.items.forEach(m=>pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(m.id)); });

item.name: 13 沿父消息获取当前上下文

exec: pm.test("上下文沿当前分支", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(6); pm.expect(b.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("first_user")); pm.expect(b.items[5].id).to.eql(pm.variables.get("last_stream_id")); pm.expect(b.items.map(m=>m.id)).not.to.include(pm.variables.get("regenerated_assistant")); });
